name: Nippon Yakin Kogyo Co., Ltd.
summary: Nippon Yakin Kogyo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells stainless steel sheets and processed products in Japan and internationally. The company offers corrosion resistant, heat resistant, controlled expansion, soft magnetic, and non-magnetic alloys; and high strength and neutron absorbing stainless, as well as corrosion resistant pure nickel; other stainless steel products; stainless steel floor plates, including POLKA and Checker plate; and manufacture ferronickel alloys.
